# pve_node_disk_directory (Resource)

Manages directory storage on a Proxmox VE node: a filesystem created on an unused disk, mounted under `/mnt/pve/<name>`. PVE does not support in-place directory reconfigure, so any non-key attribute change forces replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_node_disk_directory" "backup" {
  node           = "pve1"
  name           = "backup"
  device         = "/dev/sdc"
  filesystem     = "ext4"
  add_storage    = true
  cleanup_config = true
  cleanup_disks  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) The block device to create the filesystem on (e.g. `/dev/sdb`).
- `name` (String) Storage identifier. The filesystem is mounted under `/mnt/pve/<name>`.
- `node` (String) Name of the PVE node.

### Optional

- `add_storage` (Boolean) Also create a storage entry pointing at the directory in PVE.
- `cleanup_config` (Boolean) When deleting the directory, also remove the storage entry PVE created when `add_storage=true` was set. Defaults to `true`.
- `cleanup_disks` (Boolean) When deleting the directory, also wipe the underlying disk so it can be repurposed. Defaults to `true`; set to `false` to keep the disk for inspection.
- `filesystem` (String) The desired filesystem. Must be one of: `ext4`, `xfs`. PVE defaults to `ext4` when unset.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pve_node_disk_directory.backup pve1:backup
```
